note_for_reviewer: This project was developed with AI assistance, and I want to be transparent about that. I used OpenAI/ChatGPT to create the main prompt that I provided to a cloud-based AI coding tool. That prompt served as the initial foundation and helped establish the project's basic structure and direction. A single prompt did not create the complete project. After the initial generation, the project required significant setup, debugging, testing, integration work, and iterative changes. I resolved many issues myself and used ChatGPT for assistance with some bugs and technical problems when needed. The prompt included here is only the main/base prompt used to start the project; it is not presented as a complete record of every AI interaction used during development.

ai_usage.purpose: Created the main/base prompt used with a cloud-based AI coding tool.
ai_usage.role_of_base_prompt: Provided the initial project requirements, architecture direction, and implementation foundation.
ai_usage.additional_ai_assistance: ChatGPT was also used selectively during development to troubleshoot some bugs and technical issues.

scope_of_shared_prompt: The prompt included in this file is the main/base prompt only. It is being shared to provide transparency about how the project was started, rather than representing it as the complete development history.
